prior.warning: v5 is a mixed Zoom/regular historical artifact and is not a promoted incumbent for the certified Zoom population; historical observed counts must not be carried as Zoom evidence

candidate.topology: v5 existing runtime nodes; target TRAIN evidence updates supported exact nodes; unsupported nodes remain explicit prior-only fallbacks
candidate.revealed_hand_rule: only actually revealed known_hand_class rows enter hand/action composition residuals; hidden hands are never imputed
candidate.reveal_bias_rule: within-action revealed composition is shrunk by observed revelation rate and prior strength; no missing-at-random assumption

evaluation.runtime_matcher: same v83/v5 structural matcher contract used by tools/training/evaluate_preflop_topology_candidate.py

primary_all_rows.probability: policy169 combo-weighted P(action|context) when policy169 exists; population_model frequency only where policy169 is unavailable
primary_all_rows.scope: all non-Hero certified target preflop decisions

required_hand_conditioned.scope: non-Hero certified target preflop decisions whose hand class was actually revealed

evaluation.validation_authorization: candidate-minus-prior paired 95% CI upper bound <= 0 for BOTH all-row marginal runtime log-loss and revealed-hand conditional runtime log-loss, with positive affected support and minimum revealed support
evaluation.test_confirmation: same frozen candidate and dual metrics; no reselection or parameter change

publication.successful_result: scientific candidate may advance to downstream integration/gating only
publication.rejected_or_blocked_result: persist evidence and retain all production pointers
